# Kwik Start Lube & Tune

> Kwik Start Lube & Tune is a family-owned oil change and auto repair shop on Bell St in Amarillo, Texas, owned by Eddie and Claudia Mercer, known for quick, affordable service.

## Key facts
- Business: Kwik Start Lube & Tune
- Owner: Eddie & Claudia Mercer
- Location: 7105 Bell St, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Specialties: oil changes, brake diagnosis & repair, battery replacement, general auto repair, ladies day wednesdays, same-day service
- Rating: 4.6 stars from 285 Google reviews
- Phone: (806) 351-1300
- Address: 7105 Bell St, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Hours: Mon – Fri 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM; Sunday Closed
- Services: Oil Changes, Brake Diagnosis & Repair, Battery Replacement, General Auto Repair, Ladies Day Wednesdays, Same-Day Service
